sloka: दन्तान् विदशतस्तस्य श्रूयते दशनस्वनः।यन्त्रस्यावेष्ट्यमानस्य महतो दानवैरिव ।। ६.९३.२४ ।।
transliteration: dantān vidaśatastasya śrūyate daśanasvanaḥ।yantrasyāveṣṭyamānasya mahato dānavairiva ।। 6.93.24 ।।

translations.english: When he was biting on his teeth (enraged), the sound from his teeth resembled the sound of a grinder revolved round by Danavas.
